question: Does the same query-free corpus-calibration rule preserve the DocVQA lifecycle point without labels or evaluation-document leakage?

benchmark.evaluation: MarginMerge baselines_memory.py document-disjoint 30% holdout; the same released protocol previously reproduced 0.7057 Full and 0.6708 Light10 on v0.1

transition.processor_contract: ColQwen2_5_Processor loaded from the pinned v0.2 adapter package with no max-token override and held fixed for both routes; this is an adapter-only rollout, not a complete v0.1 package upgrade because the released v0.1 processor has a different max_pixels setting.
transition.dependency_gate: The v0.1 and v0.2 adapters contain no vision tensors; additionally require bitwise-equal post-vision fields on a DocVQA canary under this processor contract.

reprforge.artifact: Query-free corpus-calibrated post-vision PCA-256 token-wise symmetric INT8 coefficients, BF16 scales, input IDs, attention masks, image grids, and one shared corpus basis.
reprforge.calibration: 8,192 visual tokens sampled deterministically from 64 query-free DocVQA pages that are document-disjoint from the official evaluation split.
reprforge.codec_selection: Unchanged corpus-calibration rule: 64 pages, rank 256, 8,192 tokens, seed 20260824, and BF16 basis for every corpus.
reprforge.forbidden_adaptation: No query, qrel, label, evaluation document, rank sweep, precision sweep, or retention-ratio selection participates in calibration.
reprforge.materialization_accounting: IR creation is reported as source-version overhead and is not charged to the later v0.2 transition; persistent physical IR bytes are always reported.

methods.raw_full: pixels -> target v0.2 Full terminal vectors
methods.raw_light10: pixels -> target v0.2 Full -> official Light geometric merge to 10% vectors
methods.raw_light05: pixels -> target v0.2 Full -> official Light geometric merge to 5% vectors
methods.reprforge_full: valid PCA-256 post-vision IR -> target v0.2 suffix -> Full terminal vectors
methods.reprforge_light10: valid PCA-256 post-vision IR -> target v0.2 suffix -> the same Light 10% operator
methods.reprforge_light05: valid PCA-256 post-vision IR -> target v0.2 suffix -> the same Light 5% operator

measurement.batch_size_reason: Frozen before output from the already observed DocVQA range of 209 to 16,252 endpoint tokens and the 24 GiB device limit; both matched routes use the same batch size.
measurement.warm_storage: local NVMe and already-materialized source-version IR
measurement.raw_build: image access, processor, host-to-device transfer, vision, target suffix/projection, document endpoint D2H, terminal serialization
measurement.replay_build: IR shard load, PCA decode, target suffix/projection, document endpoint D2H, terminal serialization
measurement.light_cost: fused official geometric merge while target endpoints remain on GPU, compact endpoint D2H, and compressed-index serialization; Full terminal serialization is not charged to a Light route
measurement.excluded_common_work: target query encoding and retrieval evaluation
measurement.timing_inference: one complete transition plus batch-level descriptive timings; do not treat batches as independent experimental seeds
measurement.terminal_compression_source: MarginMerge commit 94cdafbc5e4c17d17aaeb0c5cdf3f0238462b42a src/baselines_memory.py; endpoint input is BF16 and merge arithmetic is FP32 exactly as released
measurement.hardware: one NVIDIA RTX 4090 with the complete experiment rooted on local /root/autodl-tmp storage
measurement.artifact_boundary: Per-batch recovery shards and evaluation-only Full caches are excluded from route cost; only the selected final target index write is charged.

primary_gates.dependency: all compared canary fields bitwise equal
primary_gates.lowering: custom raw decomposition matches the official model endpoint within 1e-6 maximum absolute error
primary_gates.lifecycle: reprforge_light10 complete target-build saving versus raw_light10 >= 0.50
primary_gates.storage: physical reusable INT8 IR <= 1.10x the actually serialized 16-bit raw Full terminal bytes
primary_gates.cardinality: raw and ReprForge Light outputs retain identical per-document vector counts
primary_gates.physical_index_fidelity: direct nDCG@5 of every serialized Light index agrees within 0.0001 with the pinned official scorer's independent re-merge from its BF16 Full cache

secondary: Report 5% retention as a stress boundary; it cannot overturn the primary 10% decision.

mechanism_prediction.statistic: (ReprForge Light10 - Raw Light10) nDCG delta minus (ReprForge Full - Raw Full) nDCG delta
mechanism_prediction.interpretation_if_pass: terminal geometric merge systematically compensates enough replay distortion to reproduce the ArxivQA composition pattern
mechanism_prediction.interpretation_if_fail: ArxivQA's apparent compression compensation is benchmark-specific; retain lifecycle non-inferiority only if the primary gates still pass

claim_boundary: Post-failure mechanism regression. It tests a fixed unlabeled deployment-calibration protocol, not untouched confirmation.
